cases.title: Scenario matrix row for logout clears session and protects routes
preconditions: Testing-plan §12 Authentication lifecycle row applies (FR-38; BR-24; AC-26).
Role-matrix fixture provides at least Student and Lecturer authenticated sessions.
steps: Establish authenticated session for each role via POST /v1/auth/login.
Execute voluntary logout per FLOW-15 (POST /v1/auth/logout and client credential discard).
Attempt protected API read for each role without re-login (e.g. GET /v1/me).
Attempt protected frontend route deep link without re-login.
cases.expected: Given/When/Then per AC-26: credentials cleared, login redirect on protected routes, API returns 401 Unauthenticated until re-authentication.

cases.title: HTTP contract logout then GET /v1/me and protected resource denial
preconditions: AcademicAdmin account exists; client holds valid accessToken.
steps: POST /v1/auth/logout with Authorization Bearer accessToken; assert HTTP 200 and data.loggedOut true.
GET /v1/me without Authorization; assert HTTP 401 with error.code Unauthenticated.
GET /v1/policies without Authorization; assert HTTP 401 Unauthenticated.
cases.expected: AC-26 satisfied at API boundary: logout returns success envelope per API §4.1; protected reads require new authentication after client credential discard.

cases.title: FLOW-15 voluntary logout without returnUrl then FLOW-14 re-login
preconditions: Student authenticated via PG-01; voluntary logout path does not preserve returnUrl per FLOW-15 step 4.
steps: From authenticated student context, invoke logout (FLOW-15): POST /v1/auth/logout and clear client credentials.
Confirm landing on PG-01 with no returnUrl query parameter.
Sign in again via FRM-01 (FLOW-14).
Confirm protected student route (e.g. GET /v1/reports/attendance self-scoped) is accessible after re-login.
cases.expected: Voluntary logout does not preserve returnUrl; re-login restores authenticated access per AC-26 and FR-38.

cases.title: Staff SidebarNav logout blocks PG-06 deep link until re-login
preconditions: Lecturer logged in on desktop Chromium at PG-04 /lecturer/sessions.
Open session fixture with known sessionId; SidebarNav footer exposes Đăng xuất per 09-page-list.md §2.2.
steps: Click Đăng xuất in SidebarNav footer.
Confirm navigation to PG-01 without returnUrl query parameter.
Manually navigate to /lecturer/sessions/{sessionId}/roster.
Observe redirect to PG-01 login without roster data from prior session.
Re-authenticate and confirm PG-06 loads.
cases.expected: AC-26 UI gate: staff voluntary logout returns to PG-01; protected deep link after logout redirects to login without exposing prior session data.

cases.title: M01 auth module logout acknowledges session end without attendance mutation
preconditions: Real database transaction enabled for M01 Identity and Access.
Authenticated Lecturer actor with open session roster context in fixture.
steps: Resolve authenticated actor via M01 authenticate middleware with valid bearer token.
Invoke POST /v1/auth/logout through auth route handler.
Verify UserLoggedOut event or equivalent audit record with actorUserId and occurredAt per API §8.1.
Query attendance_records for unexpected writes tied to logout.
Simulate client credential discard and invoke GET /v1/me through authenticate middleware.
cases.expected: Logout handler returns success only; no attendance or roster mutations; authenticate middleware rejects cleared session with Unauthenticated per AC-26 and BR-24.

cases.title: Browser journey: lecturer logout from PG-04 and session list gate until re-login
preconditions: Lecturer authenticated at PG-04 with visible session rows.
Browser storage holds accessToken prior to logout.
steps: Activate Đăng xuất from staff shell and observe PG-01 load.
Verify accessToken cleared from browser storage.
Navigate to /lecturer/sessions and confirm login redirect.
Complete FRM-01 sign-in and confirm PG-04 session list renders again.
cases.expected: End-to-end browser logout journey clears credentials, blocks protected lecturer routes, and restores access only after re-authentication per AC-26.

cases.title: POST /v1/auth/logout without bearer token returns Unauthenticated
preconditions: Test client holds no Authorization header or bearer token.
steps: Send POST /v1/auth/logout without Authorization header.
Inspect HTTP status and response envelope error.code.
cases.expected: API returns HTTP 401 with error.code Unauthenticated per API §4.1; no loggedOut success payload without authentication.

cases.title: Student mobile shell logout blocks /me/attendance until re-login
preconditions: Student authenticated at PG-02 or PG-03 on mobile viewport (375px).
Student shell exposes logout in header or account menu per LAY-01 and 09-page-list.md §2.2.
steps: Activate student logout control.
Confirm navigation to PG-01 without returnUrl and cleared access token.
Navigate to /me/attendance and observe login redirect.
Re-login and confirm self-scoped attendance history restores.
cases.expected: Student FLOW-15 logout clears session; FR-15 auth gate re-applies on protected student routes without exposing prior session data per AC-26.

cases.title: Post-logout denial on role-scoped APIs until re-authentication
preconditions: Student and Lecturer each completed FLOW-15 logout with client credentials cleared.
Open session with valid qrToken and sessionId exists for denial probes.
Permission matrix §3.1 defines distinct capabilities per role when authenticated.
steps: Without Authorization, Student calls POST /v1/check-ins with valid qrToken and Idempotency-Key.
Without Authorization, Lecturer calls GET /v1/class-sessions/{sessionId}/attendance.
Without Authorization, Student calls GET /v1/reports/attendance.
Re-authenticate Student and confirm self-scoped GET /v1/reports/attendance returns HTTP 200.
cases.expected: Request evaluation pipeline rejects post-logout calls at authentication step with HTTP 401 Unauthenticated per roles §6.1; no role-scoped attendance or report data is returned until re-login per AC-26.
